title: Uwaciwe mw'itongo
intro: Ikiremwa c’akabanga carigeze kuba mu bibanza vyo hejuru vy’irema, hafi y’Ubumana kuruta uko benshi boshobora kubitahura. Yamara ubwibone bwarashize imizi, kandi igikorwa kimwe co gutera umugere carahinduye inzira y’ubuzima. None, iki gikoko kiragendagenda nk’umwansi yarahiye, kigatongana kandi kigategura imigambi gushika umusi w’isezerano ushitse. Woba ushobora guhishura akaranga k’uwo yaguye?
clues: Narigeze kuba mu bari hafi cane y’ukuhaba kw’Imana, nshirwa hejuru y’ibintu vyinshi vyaremwe.
Naremwe nkoresheje ikintu gisha, si isi canke ibumba.
Igihe nategekwa gupfukama imbere y’ikiremwa gishasha, naranse — nsunikirwa n’ico nemera ko ari co nsumba abandi.
Naracirukanwe ndavumwa, ariko amaherezo ndahabwa umwanya wo gusubira inyuma gushika igihe kizwi, cashinzwe.
Narahiye ko nzozimiza benshi uko nshoboye kwose, nkiyegera uruvyaro rwa Adamu mvuye mu mpande zose.
Ndi umwansi w’abantu bose agaragara, atangajwe, nkama nkora umugambi kandi nsemerera gushika kw’iherezo ryashinzwe.

trial.label: Ikigeragezo / Ivyabaye
options: Kubaka inyana y'inzahabu kugira abantu bayisenge .
Kwikorera intebe y’ubwami y’Umwamikazi wa Sheba mu kanya nk’ako gukubita urugohe

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Ikiruhuko gihawe gushika ku musi w'urubanza .
Yarohamye mu kiyaga ari kumwe n'ingabo .
Yahambwe ari muzima munsi y'ingoro yariko irasenyuka .
outcome.answer: Ikiruhuko gihawe gushika ku musi w'urubanza .

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
